items.title: Text AI watermarks will always be trivial to remove
items.raw_excerpt: The European Union AI Act will begin to be enforceable in August 2026, one month from now 1 . One of the biggest new requirements is Article 50 , which requires all AI outputs to be “detectable as artificially generated”. In other words, if LLM providers want to do business in the EU, they will have to apply a watermark to their outputs 2 : some hidden signature that can be used to identify AI content.

title_i18n.en: Text AI watermarks will always be trivial to remove
title_i18n.zh: AI文本水印总是很容易被移除。
title_i18n.es: Las marcas de agua de IA en textos siempre serán triviales de eliminar.

excerpt_i18n.en: The European Union AI Act will begin to be enforceable in August 2026, one month from now 1 . One of the biggest new requirements is Article 50 , which requires all AI outputs to be “detectable as artificially generated”. In other words, if LLM providers want to do business in the EU, they will have to apply a watermark to their outputs 2 : some hidden signature that can be used to identify AI content.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 欧盟《人工智能法案》将于2026年8月开始实施，距今还有一个月。其中最大的新要求之一是第50条，该条款要求所有人工智能输出内容必须“可被识别为人工生成”。
excerpt_i18n.es: La Ley de Inteligencia Artificial de la Unión Europea comenzará a ser aplicable en agosto de 2026, dentro de un mes a partir de ahora 1. Uno de los mayores requisitos nuevos es el Artículo 50, que exige que todos los resultados de IA sean «detectables como generados artificialmente».

items.title: Needle2: 14MB agentic LLM for phones, wearables, smart home and robots
items.raw_excerpt: Hey HN, Henry from Cactus here! We previously released Cactus Needle, a 14MB agentic LLM for tool call, device use, and structured extraction for phones, wearables, smart homes, small robots and microcontrollers. We got really great feedback here, and have now incorporated the suggestions to release Needle 2. The whole model is a single 14MB binary that runs a full session in 28MB of RAM; 45m parameters at 2bit compression. Needle hits 500 tokens/sec decode speed on a Raspberry Pi 5, sits between 400-1,500 tokens/sec on VR devices like Meta Quest 3S and Apple Vision Pro, and ranges 300-700 on sub-$200 phones such as the Samsung A-Series. On the tool call and mobile device use benchmarks, Needle 2 trades wins with closest small models like LFM2.5 230M and Apple Foundation Model, at 5x to 70

items.title: Stoa Markets (YC S26) – A Marketplace for GPUs and AI Servers
items.raw_excerpt: Hi HN, we’re Eren, Berat and Kaan. We’re building Stoa ( https://www.stoaexchange.com ), a marketplace for new and used GPUs and AI servers. GPUs are the collateral in the data center buildout. Today, financing terms mostly depend on the offtaker, meaning the company that has committed to use the compute. If that company is a hyperscaler, the financing can look investment grade. If it’s a smaller cloud or startup, terms get expensive fast, even with the same hardware as collateral. The lender’s problem is pretty reasonable. If the borrower defaults and we need to sell these servers, what can we actually get for them? There isn’t a good answer today. items.title: How nOps shipped FinOps agents 75% faster with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.raw_excerpt: nOps rebuilt its Clara FinOps AI agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, replacing a self-managed Amazon EKS stack running LangChain and LangGraph. The move cut time-to-production by 75% (from 10-12 months to 4 months), improved response quality, and reduced operational overhead while keeping analytics governed through Databricks Lakehouse Metric Views.

title_i18n.en: How nOps shipped FinOps agents 75% faster with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
title_i18n.zh: nOps如何借助Amazon Bedrock AgentCore将FinOps代理的交付速度提升75%
title_i18n.es: Cómo nOps lanzó agentes de FinOps un 75% más rápido con Amazon Bedrock AgentCore

excerpt_i18n.en: nOps rebuilt its Clara FinOps AI agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, replacing a self-managed Amazon EKS stack running LangChain and LangGraph. The move cut time-to-production by 75% (from 10-12 months to 4 months), improved response quality, and reduced operational overhead while keeping analytics governed through Databricks Lakehouse Metric Views.
excerpt_i18n.zh: nOps 在 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 上重建了其 Clara FinOps AI 代理，取代了运行 LangChain 和 LangGraph 的自管理 Amazon EKS 堆栈。这一转变将生产就绪时间缩短了 75%（从 10-12 个月降至 4 个月），并改善了。
